turns.text: Should I set the fader balance before adding EQ and compression?

Ask only the most decision-changing clarification, then present no more than one reversible experiment. Candidate experiment: Bypass nonessential processing, loop the fullest representative section, and build a 60-second fader-only hierarchy from the most important element outward.
That helped, but now something important sounds weaker.
Acknowledge the benefit and cost, refer to the exact previous experiment, reduce/reposition the move rather than restarting, and explain the tradeoff.
Explain the causal tradeoff in plain language and connect it to this reusable principle: Balance is a relationship among musical roles, not a collection of target meter numbers.
